import uuid
import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient

from app.core.database import async_session_factory
from app.core.security import hash_password
from app.main import app
from app.models.enums import UserRole, VideoStatus, VideoVisibility
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.video import Video


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def client():
    transport = ASGITransport(app=app)
    async with AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as c:
        yield c


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_auth_registration_and_login_flow(client: AsyncClient):
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    username = f"user_{suffix}"
    email = f"user_{suffix}@example.com"
    password = "StrongPassword123!"

    # 1. Registration
    reg_resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/register",
        json={
            "email": email,
            "username": username,
            "password": password,
            "channel_name": f"Channel of {username}",
        },
    )
    assert reg_resp.status_code == 201, reg_resp.text
    reg_data = reg_resp.json()
    assert reg_data["user"]["username"] == username
    assert reg_data["user"]["role"] == "user"
    assert "access_token" in reg_data
    assert "access_token" in reg_resp.cookies
    assert "refresh_token" in reg_resp.cookies

    # 2. Duplicate registration returns 409
    dup_resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/register",
        json={
            "email": email,
            "username": username,
            "password": password,
        },
    )
    assert dup_resp.status_code == 409

    # 3. Login
    login_resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": username, "password": password},
    )
    assert login_resp.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in login_resp.cookies

    # 4. Profile /me with cookie
    me_resp = await client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", cookies=login_resp.cookies)
    assert me_resp.status_code == 200
    assert me_resp.json()["username"] == username

    # 5. Invalid credentials return 401
    bad_login = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": username, "password": "WrongPassword!"},
    )
    assert bad_login.status_code == 401


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_rbac_protection(client: AsyncClient):
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]

    async with async_session_factory() as session:
        norm_user = User(
            email=f"norm_{suffix}@example.com",
            username=f"norm_{suffix}",
            password_hash=hash_password("password"),
            role=UserRole.USER,
            channel_name="Norm",
        )
        mod_user = User(
            email=f"mod_{suffix}@example.com",
            username=f"mod_{suffix}",
            password_hash=hash_password("password"),
            role=UserRole.MODERATOR,
            channel_name="Mod",
        )
        session.add_all([norm_user, mod_user])
        await session.commit()

    # Anonymous user gets 401

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_video_access_control_and_grant_flow(client: AsyncClient):
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]

    # Users: Owner, Friend, Stranger
    owner = User(
        email=f"owner_{suffix}@example.com",
        username=f"owner_{suffix}",
        password_hash=hash_password("password"),
        role=UserRole.USER,
        channel_name="Owner Channel",
    )
    friend = User(
        email=f"friend_{suffix}@example.com",
        username=f"friend_{suffix}",
        password_hash=hash_password("password"),
        role=UserRole.USER,
        channel_name="Friend Channel",
    )
    stranger = User(
        email=f"stranger_{suffix}@example.com",
        username=f"stranger_{suffix}",
        password_hash=hash_password("password"),
        role=UserRole.USER,
        channel_name="Stranger Channel",
    )

    async with async_session_factory() as session:
        session.add_all([owner, friend, stranger])
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(owner)
        await session.refresh(friend)
        await session.refresh(stranger)

        private_video = Video(
            owner_id=owner.id,
            title="Secret Video",
            description="Very secret",
            status=VideoStatus.READY,
            visibility=VideoVisibility.PRIVATE,
            is_hidden=False,
        )
        session.add(private_video)
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(private_video)
        video_id = private_video.id

    # 1. Anonymous request to private video returns 403 Forbidden
    anon_resp = await client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}")
    assert anon_resp.status_code == 403

    # 2. Stranger request returns 403 Forbidden
    stranger_login = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": stranger.username, "password": "password"},
    )
    stranger_resp = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}",
        cookies=stranger_login.cookies,
    )
    assert stranger_resp.status_code == 403

    # 3. Owner request returns 200 OK
    owner_login = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": owner.username, "password": "password"},
    )
    owner_resp = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}",
        cookies=owner_login.cookies,
    )
    assert owner_resp.status_code == 200

    # 4. Stranger cannot grant access to someone else's video (403 Forbidden)
    bad_grant = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/access",
        json={"username_or_email": stranger.username},
        cookies=stranger_login.cookies,
    )
    assert bad_grant.status_code == 403

    # 5. Owner grants access to friend
    grant_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/access",
        json={"username_or_email": friend.username},
        cookies=owner_login.cookies,
    )
    assert grant_resp.status_code == 201

    # 6. Friend can now view the private video (200 OK)
    friend_login = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": friend.username, "password": "password"},
    )
    friend_resp = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}",
        cookies=friend_login.cookies,
    )
    assert friend_resp.status_code == 200

    # 7. Owner revokes access from friend
    revoke_resp = await client.delete(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/access/{friend.id}",
        cookies=owner_login.cookies,
    )
    assert revoke_resp.status_code == 204

    # 8. Friend loses access (403 Forbidden)
    friend_after_revoke = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}",
        cookies=friend_login.cookies,
    )
    assert friend_after_revoke.status_code == 403

async def close_redis_client() -> None:
    """Close the shared Redis client on application shutdown."""
    global _redis_client

def is_valid_video_header(chunk: bytes) -> bool:
    """
    Validate that file begins with valid video magic bytes:
    - MP4 / MOV: 'ftyp' at offset 4 (e.g. ftypisom, ftypmp42, etc.)
    - WebM / MKV: Matroska/EBML header \x1a\x45\xdf\xa3
    """
    if len(chunk) < 8:
        return False

    # Check EBML / WebM / MKV
    if chunk.startswith(b"\x1a\x45\xdf\xa3"):
        return True

    # Check MP4 / MOV / QuickTime: 4 bytes box size + 'ftyp'
    if len(chunk) >= 12 and chunk[4:8] == b"ftyp":
        return True

    return False


def is_valid_image_header(chunk: bytes) -> bool:
    """
    Validate that file begins with valid image magic bytes:
    - JPEG: \xff\xd8\xff
    - PNG: \x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n
    - WebP: RIFF....WEBP
    """
    if len(chunk) < 4:
        return False

    # JPEG
    if chunk.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff"):
        return True

    # PNG
    if chunk.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
        return True

    # WebP: 'RIFF' + 4 bytes size + 'WEBP'
    if len(chunk) >= 12 and chunk.startswith(b"RIFF") and chunk[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        return True

    return False

import uuid
from typing import BinaryIO

from fastapi import UploadFile
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.exceptions import BadRequestException
from app.core.queue import enqueue_video_processing
from app.core.storage import get_s3_client
from app.core.validators import is_valid_image_header, is_valid_video_header
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, VideoVisibility
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.video import Video
from app.repositories.video import VideoRepository
from app.schemas.video import VideoBaseResponse


class MediaService:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.video_repo = VideoRepository(session)

    async def upload_video(
        self,
        owner: User,
        title: str,
        description: str | None,
        visibility: VideoVisibility,
        video_file: UploadFile,
        thumbnail_file: UploadFile | None = None,
    ) -> VideoBaseResponse:
        """
        Validate magic bytes and stream file directly to MinIO without loading into RAM.
        """
        # 1. Read first chunk to validate magic bytes
        first_chunk = await video_file.read(1024)
        if not is_valid_video_header(first_chunk):
            raise BadRequestException(
                "Недопустимый формат файла. Разрешены только видео (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV)"
            )

        video_id = uuid.uuid4()
        raw_key = f"raw/{video_id}.bin"
        thumbnail_key = None

        # 2. If thumbnail provided, validate and upload it
        if thumbnail_file and thumbnail_file.filename:
            thumb_header = await thumbnail_file.read(1024)
            if not is_valid_image_header(thumb_header):
                raise BadRequestException(
                    "Недопустимый формат превью. Разрешены только JPEG, PNG, WebP"
                )
            thumbnail_key = f"thumbnails/{video_id}_custom.jpg"

            async with get_s3_client() as s3:
                # Stream custom thumbnail
                async def thumb_stream():
                    yield thumb_header
                    while chunk := await thumbnail_file.read(64 * 1024):
                        yield chunk

                # Upload thumbnail
                # Since thumbnail is small, read into bytes or multipart
                thumb_body = thumb_header + await thumbnail_file.read()
                await s3.put_object(
                    Bucket=settings.MINIO_THUMBNAILS_BUCKET,
                    Key=thumbnail_key,
                    Body=thumb_body,
                    ContentType=thumbnail_file.content_type or "image/jpeg",
                )

        # 3. Stream raw video to MinIO using multipart upload
        max_bytes = settings.MAX_VIDEO_SIZE_MB * 1024 * 1024
        total_size = len(first_chunk)

        async with get_s3_client() as s3:
            mpu = await s3.create_multipart_upload(
                Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET,
                Key=raw_key,
                ContentType=video_file.content_type or "video/mp4",
            )
            upload_id = mpu["UploadId"]
            parts = []
            part_number = 1

            current_part_data = bytearray(first_chunk)
            min_part_size = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # S3 5MB minimum per part

            try:
                while chunk := await video_file.read(1024 * 1024):
                    total_size += len(chunk)
                    if total_size > max_bytes:
                        raise BadRequestException(
                            f"Размер файла превышает лимит {settings.MAX_VIDEO_SIZE_MB} МБ"
                        )
                    current_part_data.extend(chunk)

                    if len(current_part_data) >= min_part_size:
                        part_res = await s3.upload_part(
                            Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET,
                            Key=raw_key,
                            PartNumber=part_number,
                            UploadId=upload_id,
                            Body=bytes(current_part_data),
                        )
                        parts.append({"PartNumber": part_number, "ETag": part_res["ETag"]})
                        part_number += 1
                        current_part_data.clear()

                # Upload remaining part
                if current_part_data:
                    part_res = await s3.upload_part(
                        Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET,
                        Key=raw_key,
                        PartNumber=part_number,
                        UploadId=upload_id,
                        Body=bytes(current_part_data),
                    )
                    parts.append({"PartNumber": part_number, "ETag": part_res["ETag"]})

                await s3.complete_multipart_upload(
                    Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET,
                    Key=raw_key,
                    UploadId=upload_id,
                    MultipartUpload={"Parts": parts},
                )
            except Exception:
                await s3.abort_multipart_upload(
                    Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET,
                    Key=raw_key,
                    UploadId=upload_id,
                )
                raise

        # 4. Save video record in database with status 'processing'
        video = Video(
            id=video_id,
            owner_id=owner.id,
            title=title,
            description=description,
            status=VideoStatus.PROCESSING,
            visibility=visibility,
            raw_object_key=raw_key,
            thumbnail_object_key=thumbnail_key,
        )
        await self.video_repo.create(video)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(video)

        # 5. Enqueue processing task
        await enqueue_video_processing(str(video_id))

        return VideoBaseResponse.model_validate(video)

import asyncio
import json

import tempfile
import uuid

from arq.connections import RedisSettings

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import async_session_factory
from app.core.storage import get_s3_client
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus
from app.models.video import Video

logger = logging.getLogger("worker")
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)


async def get_video_duration(file_path: str) -> int:
    """Use ffprobe to extract duration in seconds."""
    cmd = [
        "ffprobe",
        "-v",
        "error",
        "-show_entries",
        "format=duration",
        "-of",
        "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1",
        file_path,
    ]
    proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
        *cmd, stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE, stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE
    )
    stdout, stderr = await proc.communicate()
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ffprobe error: {stderr.decode()}")
    try:
        return int(float(stdout.decode().strip()))
    except Exception:
        return 0


async def transcode_to_faststart_mp4(input_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    """Transcode video to H.264 / AAC MP4 with faststart flag for instant web streaming."""
    cmd = [
        "ffmpeg",
        "-y",
        "-i",
        input_path,
        "-c:v",
        "libx264",
        "-preset",
        "veryfast",
        "-crf",
        "23",
        "-c:a",
        "aac",
        "-b:a",
        "128k",
        "-movflags",
        "+faststart",
        output_path,
    ]
    proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
        *cmd, stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE, stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE
    )
    _, stderr = await proc.communicate()
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ffmpeg transcode error: {stderr.decode()[:500]}")


async def generate_thumbnail(input_path: str, output_path: str, at_second: int = 2) -> None:
    """Extract frame at at_second (or 00:00:01) as JPEG thumbnail."""
    cmd = [
        "ffmpeg",
        "-y",
        "-ss",
        f"00:00:{at_second:02d}",
        "-i",
        input_path,
        "-vframes",
        "1",
        "-q:v",
        "2",
        output_path,
    ]
    proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
        *cmd, stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE, stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE
    )
    _, stderr = await proc.communicate()
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        # Fallback to second 0
        cmd[2] = "00:00:00"
        proc2 = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(*cmd)
        await proc2.communicate()


async def process_video(ctx: dict, video_id_str: str) -> str:
    """Background task: download raw video, transcode to H.264/AAC, generate thumb, upload."""
    video_id = uuid.UUID(video_id_str)
    logger.info(f"Starting processing for video {video_id}")

    tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"video_{video_id}_")
    try:
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            video = await session.get(Video, video_id)
            if not video or not video.raw_object_key:
                logger.error(f"Video {video_id} not found or no raw_key")
                return f"Video {video_id} not found"

            raw_key = video.raw_object_key
            custom_thumb_key = video.thumbnail_object_key

        local_raw = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "raw_video.bin")
        local_processed = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "processed.mp4")
        local_thumb = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "thumb.jpg")

        # 1. Download raw file from S3
        async with get_s3_client() as s3:
            raw_obj = await s3.get_object(
                Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET, Key=raw_key
            )
            with open(local_raw, "wb") as f:
                async for chunk in raw_obj["Body"].iter_chunks():
                    f.write(chunk)

        # 2. Extract metadata
        duration = await get_video_duration(local_raw)

        # 3. Transcode to faststart mp4
        await transcode_to_faststart_mp4(local_raw, local_processed)

        # 4. Generate thumbnail if not provided
        thumbnail_key = custom_thumb_key
        if not thumbnail_key:
            thumb_sec = min(2, max(0, duration - 1))
            await generate_thumbnail(local_raw, local_thumb, at_second=thumb_sec)
            if os.path.exists(local_thumb) and os.path.getsize(local_thumb) > 0:
                thumbnail_key = f"thumbnails/{video_id}.jpg"
                async with get_s3_client() as s3:
                    with open(local_thumb, "rb") as f:
                        await s3.put_object(
                            Bucket=settings.MINIO_THUMBNAILS_BUCKET,
                            Key=thumbnail_key,
                            Body=f.read(),
                            ContentType="image/jpeg",
                        )

        # 5. Upload processed mp4 to S3
        processed_key = f"processed/{video_id}.mp4"
        async with get_s3_client() as s3:
            with open(local_processed, "rb") as f:
                await s3.put_object(
                    Bucket=settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET,
                    Key=processed_key,
                    Body=f.read(),
                    ContentType="video/mp4",
                )

        # 6. Update database record to 'ready'
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            await session.execute(
                update(Video)
                .where(Video.id == video_id)
                .values(
                    status=VideoStatus.READY,
                    duration_seconds=duration,
                    processed_object_key=processed_key,
                    thumbnail_object_key=thumbnail_key,
                    error_message=None,
                )
            )
            await session.commit()

        logger.info(f"Video {video_id} processed successfully to ready status")
        return f"Video {video_id} ready"

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception(f"Error processing video {video_id}: {exc}")
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            await session.execute(
                update(Video)
                .where(Video.id == video_id)
                .values(
                    status=VideoStatus.FAILED,
                    error_message=str(exc)[:500],
                )
            )
            await session.commit()
        return f"Video {video_id} failed: {exc}"
    finally:
        # Guaranteed cleanup of local temp files
        shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)


class WorkerSettings:
    """Arq worker configuration for background video processing."""

    functions = [process_video]
    redis_settings = RedisSettings.from_dsn(settings.REDIS_URL)
    max_jobs = 4
    job_timeout = 1800

@router.get(
    "/{video_id}/thumbnail",
    summary="Отдача превью видео с поддержкой X-Accel-Redirect",
)
async def get_video_thumbnail(
    video_id: uuid.UUID,
    response: Response,
    db: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
    current_user: Annotated[User | None, Depends(get_optional_user)],
) -> Response:
    video_repo = VideoRepository(db)
    video = await video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
    if not video or not video.thumbnail_object_key:
        raise NotFoundException("Превью не найдено")

    access_service = VideoAccessService(db)
    can_view, _ = await access_service.can_view_video(video, current_user)
    if not can_view:
        raise ForbiddenException("Доступ к превью ограничен")

    response.headers["X-Accel-Redirect"] = (
        f"/_internal_s3/{settings.MINIO_THUMBNAILS_BUCKET}/{video.thumbnail_object_key}"
    )
    response.headers["Content-Type"] = "image/jpeg"
    return response

docker compose exec backend python -c "
import asyncio, os, time, uuid
import httpx

async def main():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url='http://nginx') as client:
        # 1. Register test user
        suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
        username = f'creator_{suffix}'
        password = 'Password123!'
        reg = await client.post('/api/v1/auth/register', json={
            'email': f'{username}@example.com',
            'username': username,
            'password': password,
            'channel_name': f'Channel {username}',
        })
        print('Register status:', reg.status_code)
        cookies = reg.cookies

        # 2. Upload sample.mp4
        with open('/tmp/sample.mp4', 'rb') as f:
            files = {'video': ('sample.mp4', f, 'video/mp4')}
            data = {'title': 'Sample Test Video', 'description': 'Testing FFmpeg pipeline', 'visibility': 'public'}
            up_resp = await client.post('/api/v1/videos/upload', data=data, files=files, cookies=cookies)
        print('Upload status:', up_resp.status_code)
        video_data = up_resp.json()
        video_id = video_data['id']
        print(f'Uploaded video {video_id}, initial status: {video_data[\"status\"]}')

        # 3. Wait for Arq worker to process video to 'ready'
        ready = False
        for _ in range(30):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            v_resp = await client.get(f'/api/v1/videos/{video_id}', cookies=cookies)
            status = v_resp.json()['status']
            print('Current video status:', status)
            if status == 'ready':
                ready = True
                print('Video ready! Details:', v_resp.json())
                break
            elif status == 'failed':
                print('Processing failed:', v_resp.json())
                break

        assert ready, 'Video did not become ready'

        # 4. Request video stream with Range header
        headers = {'Range': 'bytes=0-1024'}
        stream_resp = await client.get(f'/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/stream', headers=headers)
        print('Stream HTTP status:', stream_resp.status_code)
        print('Content-Range:', stream_resp.headers.get('content-range'))
        print('Content-Length:', stream_resp.headers.get('content-length'))
        print('Accept-Ranges:', stream_resp.headers.get('accept-ranges'))
        print('Bytes received:', len(stream_resp.content))
        assert stream_resp.status_code == 206
        assert len(stream_resp.content) == 1025

asyncio.run(main())
"

import asyncio
import os
import time
import uuid
import httpx


async def main():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url="http://nginx") as client:
        # 1. Register test user
        suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
        username = f"creator_{suffix}"
        password = "Password123!"
        reg = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/auth/register",
            json={
                "email": f"{username}@example.com",
                "username": username,
                "password": password,
                "channel_name": f"Channel {username}",
            },
        )
        print("Register status:", reg.status_code)
        cookies = reg.cookies

        # 2. Upload sample.mp4
        with open("/tmp/sample.mp4", "rb") as f:
            files = {"video": ("sample.mp4", f, "video/mp4")}
            data = {
                "title": "Sample Test Video",
                "description": "Testing FFmpeg pipeline",
                "visibility": "public",
            }
            up_resp = await client.post(
                "/api/v1/videos/upload",
                data=data,
                files=files,
                cookies=cookies,
            )
        print("Upload status:", up_resp.status_code)
        video_data = up_resp.json()
        video_id = video_data["id"]
        print(f"Uploaded video {video_id}, initial status: {video_data['status']}")

        # 3. Wait for Arq worker to process video to 'ready'
        ready = False
        for i in range(30):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            v_resp = await client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}", cookies=cookies)
            v_info = v_resp.json()
            curr_status = v_info["status"]
            print(f"[{i+1}s] Current video status: {curr_status}")
            if curr_status == "ready":
                ready = True
                print("Video successfully processed to ready!")
                print("Duration:", v_info.get("duration_seconds"))
                print("Thumbnail object key:", v_info.get("thumbnail_object_key"))
                break
            elif curr_status == "failed":
                print("Processing failed:", v_info.get("hidden_reason") or v_info)
                break

        assert ready, "Video did not become ready"

        # 4. Request video stream with Range header: bytes=0-1024
        headers = {"Range": "bytes=0-1024"}
        stream_resp = await client.get(
            f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/stream", headers=headers
        )
        print("Stream HTTP status:", stream_resp.status_code)
        print("Content-Range header:", stream_resp.headers.get("content-range"))
        print("Content-Length header:", stream_resp.headers.get("content-length"))
        print("Accept-Ranges header:", stream_resp.headers.get("accept-ranges"))
        print("Bytes received:", len(stream_resp.content))
        assert stream_resp.status_code == 206
        assert len(stream_resp.content) == 1025

        # 5. Check thumbnail access
        thumb_resp = await client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/thumbnail")
        print("Thumbnail HTTP status:", thumb_resp.status_code)
        print("Thumbnail content-type:", thumb_resp.headers.get("content-type"))
        assert thumb_resp.status_code == 200
        assert len(thumb_resp.content) > 0

        print("=== ALL STAGE 4 MEDIA PIPELINE CHECKS PASSED ===")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

    description=(
        "Проверяет права доступа к видео. При успехе возвращает заголовок X-Accel-Redirect "
        "для мгновенной раздачи через Nginx с поддержкой Range-запросов (206 Partial Content)."
    ),
)
async def stream_video(
    video_id: uuid.UUID,
    response: Response,
    db: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
    current_user: Annotated[User | None, Depends(get_optional_user)],
) -> Response:
    video_repo = VideoRepository(db)
    video = await video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
    if not video:
        raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

    access_service = VideoAccessService(db)
    can_view, reason = await access_service.can_view_video(video, current_user)
    if not can_view:
        raise ForbiddenException(reason or "Доступ запрещен")

    key = video.processed_object_key or video.raw_object_key
    if not key:
        raise NotFoundException("Медиафайл видео не готов")

    # Pass to Nginx internal location
    response.headers["X-Accel-Redirect"] = f"/_internal_s3/{settings.MINIO_VIDEOS_BUCKET}/{key}"
    response.headers["Content-Type"] = "video/mp4"
    return response


@router.get(
    "/{video_id}/thumbnail",
    summary="Отдача превью видео с поддержкой X-Accel-Redirect",
)
async def get_video_thumbnail(
    video_id: uuid.UUID,
    response: Response,
    db: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
    current_user: Annotated[User | None, Depends(get_optional_user)],
) -> Response:
    video_repo = VideoRepository(db)
    video = await video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
    if not video or not video.thumbnail_object_key:
        raise NotFoundException("Превью не найдено")

    access_service = VideoAccessService(db)
    can_view, _ = await access_service.can_view_video(video, current_user)
    if not can_view:
        raise ForbiddenException("Доступ к превью ограничен")

    response.headers["X-Accel-Redirect"] = (
        f"/_internal_s3/{settings.MINIO_THUMBNAILS_BUCKET}/{video.thumbnail_object_key}"
    )
    response.headers["Content-Type"] = "image/jpeg"
    return response

2. **Фоновый воркер обработки медиа (`app/worker.py`):**
   - Забирает задачу из очереди Redis.

   - Оптимизирует видео для веба через `ffmpeg`: контейнер MP4, видеокодек H.264 (`-preset veryfast -crf 23`), аудиокодек AAC, флаг `-movflags +faststart` для мгновенного старта и перемотки в браузере.

import uuid
from collections.abc import Sequence

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, or_, select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.models.community import Comment, Report, Subscription, VideoReaction
from app.models.enums import ReportStatus, VideoStatus, VideoVisibility
from app.models.playlist import Playlist, PlaylistItem
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.video import Video


class SocialRepository:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # --- View Counter ---
    async def increment_views(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
        stmt = (
            update(Video)
            .where(Video.id == video_id)
            .values(views_count=Video.views_count + 1)
            .returning(Video.views_count)
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        val = res.scalar_one_or_none()
        await self.session.commit()
        return val or 0

    # --- Reactions ---
    async def get_user_reaction(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> int | None:
        stmt = select(VideoReaction.value).where(
            VideoReaction.video_id == video_id,
            VideoReaction.user_id == user_id,
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def set_reaction(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID, value: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
        """Set, update, or remove (-1, 0, 1) reaction and atomically update video counts."""
        stmt = select(VideoReaction).where(
            VideoReaction.video_id == video_id,
            VideoReaction.user_id == user_id,
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        existing = res.scalar_one_or_none()

        old_val = existing.value if existing else 0
        new_val = value if value in (1, -1) else 0

        if old_val == new_val:
            # No change
            video = await self.session.get(Video, video_id)
            return (video.likes_count, video.dislikes_count) if video else (0, 0)

        # Update VideoReaction table
        if existing:
            if new_val == 0:
                await self.session.delete(existing)
            else:
                existing.value = new_val
        else:
            if new_val != 0:
                self.session.add(VideoReaction(video_id=video_id, user_id=user_id, value=new_val))

        # Calculate deltas
        likes_delta = (1 if new_val == 1 else 0) - (1 if old_val == 1 else 0)
        dislikes_delta = (1 if new_val == -1 else 0) - (1 if old_val == -1 else 0)

        update_stmt = (
            update(Video)
            .where(Video.id == video_id)
            .values(
                likes_count=func.greatest(0, Video.likes_count + likes_delta),
                dislikes_count=func.greatest(0, Video.dislikes_count + dislikes_delta),
            )
            .returning(Video.likes_count, Video.dislikes_count)
        )
        up_res = await self.session.execute(update_stmt)
        row = up_res.first()
        await self.session.commit()
        return (row[0], row[1]) if row else (0, 0)

    # --- Comments ---
    async def create_comment(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, author_id: uuid.UUID, content: str) -> Comment:
        comment = Comment(video_id=video_id, author_id=author_id, content=content)
        self.session.add(comment)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(comment)
        stmt = select(Comment).where(Comment.id == comment.id).options(selectinload(Comment.author))
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one()

    async def get_comment(self, comment_id: uuid.UUID) -> Comment | None:
        stmt = select(Comment).where(Comment.id == comment_id).options(selectinload(Comment.author), selectinload(Comment.video))
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def list_comments(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> Sequence[Comment]:
        stmt = (
            select(Comment)
            .where(Comment.video_id == video_id, Comment.is_deleted.is_(False))
            .options(selectinload(Comment.author))
            .order_by(Comment.created_at.desc())
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalars().all()

    async def delete_comment(self, comment_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
        stmt = (
            update(Comment)
            .where(Comment.id == comment_id)
            .values(is_deleted=True)
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        await self.session.commit()
        return (res.rowcount or 0) > 0

    # --- Subscriptions & Channels ---
    async def get_subscribers_count(self, channel_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
        stmt = select(func.count(Subscription.id)).where(Subscription.channel_id == channel_id)
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar() or 0

    async def is_subscribed(self, subscriber_id: uuid.UUID, channel_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
        stmt = select(Subscription.id).where(
            Subscription.subscriber_id == subscriber_id,
            Subscription.channel_id == channel_id,
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one_or_none() is not None

    async def toggle_subscription(self, subscriber_id: uuid.UUID, channel_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
        """Returns True if subscribed, False if unsubscribed."""
        stmt = select(Subscription).where(
            Subscription.subscriber_id == subscriber_id,
            Subscription.channel_id == channel_id,
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        sub = res.scalar_one_or_none()
        if sub:
            await self.session.delete(sub)
            await self.session.commit()
            return False
        else:
            self.session.add(Subscription(subscriber_id=subscriber_id, channel_id=channel_id))
            await self.session.commit()
            return True

    # --- Playlists ---
    async def create_playlist(self, owner_id: uuid.UUID, title: str, description: str | None, is_public: bool) -> Playlist:
        pl = Playlist(owner_id=owner_id, title=title, description=description, is_public=is_public)
        self.session.add(pl)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(pl)
        return pl

    async def get_playlist(self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID) -> Playlist | None:
        stmt = (
            select(Playlist)
            .where(Playlist.id == playlist_id)
            .options(
                selectinload(Playlist.owner),
                selectinload(Playlist.items).selectinload(PlaylistItem.video).selectinload(Video.owner),
            )
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def add_to_playlist(self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> PlaylistItem:
        # Get max position
        pos_stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.max(PlaylistItem.position), -1)).where(PlaylistItem.playlist_id == playlist_id)
        pos_res = await self.session.execute(pos_stmt)
        next_pos = (pos_res.scalar() or -1) + 1

        item = PlaylistItem(playlist_id=playlist_id, video_id=video_id, position=next_pos)
        self.session.add(item)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(item)
        return item

    async def remove_from_playlist(self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
        stmt = delete(PlaylistItem).where(
            PlaylistItem.playlist_id == playlist_id,
            PlaylistItem.video_id == video_id,
        )
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        await self.session.commit()
        return (res.rowcount or 0) > 0

    async def delete_playlist(self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
        stmt = delete(Playlist).where(Playlist.id == playlist_id)
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        await self.session.commit()
        return (res.rowcount or 0) > 0

    # --- Reports & Moderation ---
    async def create_report(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, reporter_id: uuid.UUID, reason: str) -> Report:
        rep = Report(video_id=video_id, reporter_id=reporter_id, reason=reason, status=ReportStatus.PENDING)
        self.session.add(rep)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(rep)
        stmt = select(Report).where(Report.id == rep.id).options(selectinload(Report.reporter))
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one()

    async def list_reports(self, status: ReportStatus | None = None) -> Sequence[Report]:
        stmt = select(Report).options(selectinload(Report.reporter), selectinload(Report.moderator)).order_by(Report.created_at.desc())
        if status:
            stmt = stmt.where(Report.status == status)
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalars().all()

    async def resolve_report(self, report_id: uuid.UUID, moderator_id: uuid.UUID, action: str, comment: str | None) -> Report | None:
        report = await self.session.get(Report, report_id)
        if not report:
            return None

        report.status = ReportStatus.RESOLVED if action == "hide" else ReportStatus.DISMISSED
        report.moderator_id = moderator_id
        report.moderator_comment = comment

        if action == "hide":
            await self.session.execute(
                update(Video)
                .where(Video.id == report.video_id)
                .values(is_hidden=True, hidden_reason=comment or f"Скрыто модератором по жалобе {report_id}")
            )

        await self.session.commit()
        stmt = select(Report).where(Report.id == report_id).options(selectinload(Report.reporter), selectinload(Report.moderator))
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return res.scalar_one()

    async def unhide_video(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
        stmt = update(Video).where(Video.id == video_id).values(is_hidden=False, hidden_reason=None)
        res = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        await self.session.commit()
        return (res.rowcount or 0) > 0

import uuid
from typing import Sequence

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.exceptions import (
    BadRequestException,
    ForbiddenException,
    NotFoundException,
)
from app.core.redis import get_redis_client
from app.models.enums import ReportStatus, UserRole
from app.models.user import User
from app.repositories.social import SocialRepository
from app.repositories.user import UserRepository
from app.repositories.video import VideoRepository
from app.schemas.social import (
    ChannelProfileResponse,
    CommentResponse,
    PlaylistItemResponse,
    PlaylistResponse,
    ReactionResponse,
    ReportResponse,
    SubscriptionResponse,
)
from app.schemas.video import VideoBaseResponse


class SocialService:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.social_repo = SocialRepository(session)
        self.video_repo = VideoRepository(session)
        self.user_repo = UserRepository(session)

    # --- View deduplication ---
    async def record_view(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, client_identifier: str) -> int:
        """Deduplicate views in Redis (TTL 60s per user/IP and video)."""
        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

        redis = get_redis_client()
        view_key = f"view:{video_id}:{client_identifier}"
        # Set NX with 60s expire
        is_new = await redis.set(view_key, "1", ex=60, nx=True)
        if is_new:
            return await self.social_repo.increment_views(video_id)
        return video.views_count

    # --- Reactions ---
    async def set_reaction(
        self, video_id: uuid.UUID, user: User, value: int
    ) -> ReactionResponse:
        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

        likes, dislikes = await self.social_repo.set_reaction(video_id, user.id, value)
        user_reaction = await self.social_repo.get_user_reaction(video_id, user.id)
        return ReactionResponse(
            likes_count=likes,
            dislikes_count=dislikes,
            user_reaction=user_reaction,
        )

    # --- Comments ---
    async def add_comment(
        self, video_id: uuid.UUID, author: User, content: str
    ) -> CommentResponse:
        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

        comment = await self.social_repo.create_comment(video_id, author.id, content)
        return CommentResponse.model_validate(comment)

    async def list_comments(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[CommentResponse]:
        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

        comments = await self.social_repo.list_comments(video_id)
        return [CommentResponse.model_validate(c) for c in comments]

    async def delete_comment(self, comment_id: uuid.UUID, user: User) -> None:
        comment = await self.social_repo.get_comment(comment_id)
        if not comment or comment.is_deleted:
            raise NotFoundException("Комментарий не найден")

        # Can delete if: author of comment, owner of the video, or moderator/admin
        is_comment_author = comment.author_id == user.id
        is_video_owner = comment.video.owner_id == user.id
        is_moderator = user.role in (UserRole.MODERATOR, UserRole.ADMIN)

        if not (is_comment_author or is_video_owner or is_moderator):
            raise ForbiddenException("Недостаточно прав для удаления комментария")

        await self.social_repo.delete_comment(comment_id)

    # --- Channels & Subscriptions ---
    async def get_channel_profile(
        self, username: str, current_user: User | None
    ) -> ChannelProfileResponse:
        channel_user = await self.user_repo.get_by_username(username)
        if not channel_user:
            raise NotFoundException("Канал не найден")

        is_owner = bool(current_user and current_user.id == channel_user.id)
        subs_count = await self.social_repo.get_subscribers_count(channel_user.id)
        is_sub = (
            await self.social_repo.is_subscribed(current_user.id, channel_user.id)
            if current_user
            else False
        )
        videos_count = await self.video_repo.count_channel_videos(
            channel_user.id, is_owner=is_owner
        )

        return ChannelProfileResponse(
            id=channel_user.id,
            username=channel_user.username,
            channel_name=channel_user.channel_name,
            channel_description=channel_user.channel_description,
            avatar_key=channel_user.avatar_key,
            subscribers_count=subs_count,
            is_subscribed=is_sub,
            videos_count=videos_count,
            created_at=channel_user.created_at,
        )

    async def toggle_subscription(
        self, username: str, subscriber: User
    ) -> SubscriptionResponse:
        channel_user = await self.user_repo.get_by_username(username)
        if not channel_user:
            raise NotFoundException("Канал не найден")

        if channel_user.id == subscriber.id:
            raise BadRequestException("Нельзя подписаться на собственный канал")

        is_sub = await self.social_repo.toggle_subscription(subscriber.id, channel_user.id)
        subs_count = await self.social_repo.get_subscribers_count(channel_user.id)
        return SubscriptionResponse(is_subscribed=is_sub, subscribers_count=subs_count)

    # --- Playlists ---
    async def create_playlist(
        self, owner: User, title: str, description: str | None, is_public: bool
    ) -> PlaylistResponse:
        pl = await self.social_repo.create_playlist(owner.id, title, description, is_public)
        pl_full = await self.social_repo.get_playlist(pl.id)
        return PlaylistResponse.model_validate(pl_full)

    async def get_playlist(
        self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID, user: User | None
    ) -> PlaylistResponse:
        pl = await self.social_repo.get_playlist(playlist_id)
        if not pl:
            raise NotFoundException("Плейлист не найден")

        if not pl.is_public:
            if not user or (user.id != pl.owner_id and user.role != UserRole.ADMIN):
                raise ForbiddenException("Плейлист является приватным")

        return PlaylistResponse.model_validate(pl)

    async def add_video_to_playlist(
        self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID, video_id: uuid.UUID, user: User
    ) -> PlaylistResponse:
        pl = await self.social_repo.get_playlist(playlist_id)
        if not pl:
            raise NotFoundException("Плейлист не найден")
        if pl.owner_id != user.id and user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
            raise ForbiddenException("Только владелец может добавлять видео в плейлист")

        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

        await self.social_repo.add_to_playlist(playlist_id, video_id)
        pl_updated = await self.social_repo.get_playlist(playlist_id)
        return PlaylistResponse.model_validate(pl_updated)

    async def remove_video_from_playlist(
        self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID, video_id: uuid.UUID, user: User
    ) -> None:
        pl = await self.social_repo.get_playlist(playlist_id)
        if not pl:
            raise NotFoundException("Плейлист не найден")
        if pl.owner_id != user.id and user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
            raise ForbiddenException("Только владелец может удалять видео из плейлиста")

        deleted = await self.social_repo.remove_from_playlist(playlist_id, video_id)
        if not deleted:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено в плейлисте")

    async def delete_playlist(self, playlist_id: uuid.UUID, user: User) -> None:
        pl = await self.social_repo.get_playlist(playlist_id)
        if not pl:
            raise NotFoundException("Плейлист не найден")
        if pl.owner_id != user.id and user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
            raise ForbiddenException("Только владелец может удалить плейлист")

        await self.social_repo.delete_playlist(playlist_id)

    # --- Reports & Moderation ---
    async def create_report(
        self, video_id: uuid.UUID, reporter: User, reason: str
    ) -> ReportResponse:
        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")

        rep = await self.social_repo.create_report(video_id, reporter.id, reason)
        return ReportResponse.model_validate(rep)

    async def list_reports(self, status_filter: ReportStatus | None) -> list[ReportResponse]:
        reports = await self.social_repo.list_reports(status_filter)
        return [ReportResponse.model_validate(r) for r in reports]

    async def resolve_report(
        self, report_id: uuid.UUID, moderator: User, action: str, comment: str | None
    ) -> ReportResponse:
        rep = await self.social_repo.resolve_report(report_id, moderator.id, action, comment)
        if not rep:
            raise NotFoundException("Жалоба не найдена")
        return ReportResponse.model_validate(rep)

    async def unhide_video(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
        video = await self.video_repo.get_by_id(video_id)
        if not video:
            raise NotFoundException("Видео не найдено")
        await self.social_repo.unhide_video(video_id)

import uuid
import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient

from app.core.database import async_session_factory
from app.core.security import hash_password
from app.main import app
from app.models.enums import UserRole, VideoStatus, VideoVisibility
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.video import Video


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def client():
    transport = ASGITransport(app=app)
    async with AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as c:
        yield c


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_social_features_and_moderation_flow(client: AsyncClient):
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]

    # 1. Create users: author, viewer, moderator
    async with async_session_factory() as session:
        author = User(
            email=f"author_{suffix}@example.com",
            username=f"author_{suffix}",
            password_hash=hash_password("password"),
            role=UserRole.USER,
            channel_name=f"Channel {suffix}",
            channel_description="Awesome videos",
        )
        viewer = User(
            email=f"viewer_{suffix}@example.com",
            username=f"viewer_{suffix}",
            password_hash=hash_password("password"),
            role=UserRole.USER,
            channel_name=f"Viewer {suffix}",
        )
        moderator = User(
            email=f"mod_{suffix}@example.com",
            username=f"mod_{suffix}",
            password_hash=hash_password("password"),
            role=UserRole.MODERATOR,
            channel_name=f"Moderator {suffix}",
        )
        session.add_all([author, viewer, moderator])
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(author)
        await session.refresh(viewer)
        await session.refresh(moderator)

        # Create public ready video
        video = Video(
            owner_id=author.id,
            title="FastAPI & React Full Tutorial",
            description="Complete tutorial on building fullstack web applications",
            status=VideoStatus.READY,
            visibility=VideoVisibility.PUBLIC,
            is_hidden=False,
        )
        session.add(video)
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(video)
        video_id = video.id

    # Log in as viewer
    login_viewer = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": viewer.username, "password": "password"},
    )
    viewer_cookies = login_viewer.cookies

    # 2. Feed and Search
    feed_resp = await client.get("/api/v1/videos?sort=new")
    assert feed_resp.status_code == 200
    feed_ids = [v["id"] for v in feed_resp.json()]
    assert str(video_id) in feed_ids

    search_resp = await client.get("/api/v1/videos/search?q=Tutorial")
    assert search_resp.status_code == 200
    assert any(v["id"] == str(video_id) for v in search_resp.json())

    # 3. View recording with deduplication
    view1 = await client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/view", cookies=viewer_cookies)
    assert view1.status_code == 200
    cnt1 = view1.json()["views_count"]

    # Immediate second call within 60s window should be deduplicated
    view2 = await client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/view", cookies=viewer_cookies)
    assert view2.status_code == 200
    assert view2.json()["views_count"] == cnt1

    # 4. Reactions (like, change to dislike, remove)
    like_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/react",
        json={"value": 1},
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert like_resp.status_code == 200
    assert like_resp.json()["likes_count"] >= 1
    assert like_resp.json()["user_reaction"] == 1

    dislike_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/react",
        json={"value": -1},
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert dislike_resp.status_code == 200
    assert dislike_resp.json()["dislikes_count"] >= 1
    assert dislike_resp.json()["user_reaction"] == -1

    # 5. Comments
    comm_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/comments",
        json={"content": "Great video!"},
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert comm_resp.status_code == 201
    comment_id = comm_resp.json()["id"]

    list_comm = await client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/comments")
    assert list_comm.status_code == 200
    assert any(c["id"] == comment_id for c in list_comm.json())

    # 6. Channel & Subscription
    chan_resp = await client.get(f"/api/v1/channels/{author.username}")
    assert chan_resp.status_code == 200
    assert chan_resp.json()["username"] == author.username

    sub_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/channels/{author.username}/subscribe",
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert sub_resp.status_code == 200
    assert sub_resp.json()["is_subscribed"] is True
    assert sub_resp.json()["subscribers_count"] == 1

    # Unsubscribe
    unsub_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/channels/{author.username}/subscribe",
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert unsub_resp.status_code == 200
    assert unsub_resp.json()["is_subscribed"] is False

    # 7. Playlist CRUD
    pl_resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/playlists",
        json={"title": "Favorites", "description": "My favorite videos", "is_public": True},
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert pl_resp.status_code == 201
    playlist_id = pl_resp.json()["id"]

    add_pl_video = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist_id}/videos",
        json={"video_id": str(video_id)},
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert add_pl_video.status_code == 201
    assert len(add_pl_video.json()["items"]) == 1

    # 8. Report and Moderation flow
    rep_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}/report",
        json={"reason": "Inappropriate content"},
        cookies=viewer_cookies,
    )
    assert rep_resp.status_code == 201
    report_id = rep_resp.json()["id"]

    # Log in as moderator
    login_mod = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"username_or_email": moderator.username, "password": "password"},
    )
    mod_cookies = login_mod.cookies

    # Moderator views queue
    reports_queue = await client.get("/api/v1/moderation/reports", cookies=mod_cookies)
    assert reports_queue.status_code == 200
    assert any(r["id"] == report_id for r in reports_queue.json())

    # Moderator hides video
    resolve_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/moderation/reports/{report_id}/resolve",
        json={"action": "hide", "comment": "Violation of community standards"},
        cookies=mod_cookies,
    )
    assert resolve_resp.status_code == 200
    assert resolve_resp.json()["status"] == "resolved"

    # Hidden video disappears from public feed
    hidden_feed = await client.get("/api/v1/videos")
    assert not any(v["id"] == str(video_id) for v in hidden_feed.json())

    # Unhide video
    unhide_resp = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/moderation/videos/{video_id}/unhide",
        cookies=mod_cookies,
    )
    assert unhide_resp.status_code == 204

    # Video is back in feed
    restored_feed = await client.get("/api/v1/videos")
    assert any(v["id"] == str(video_id) for v in restored_feed.json())

  - Streaming upload (`POST /api/v1/videos/upload`) validating container magic bytes (MP4/WebM/MKV/MOV) and streaming to MinIO via multipart.
  - Arq background worker (`backend/app/worker.py`): ffprobe duration extraction, FFmpeg H.264/AAC transcode with `-movflags +faststart`, auto-thumbnail generation at 2s, upload to MinIO, DB update to `ready`.
  - Secure streaming via Nginx `X-Accel-Redirect` to MinIO with S3 presigned internal redirect, supporting `Range: bytes=0-1024` -> `206 Partial Content`.
  - Verified with real test MP4 in `backend/tests/test_media_pipeline.py`.
- **Stage 5: Feed, Search, Social, Playlists, Moderation (Commit `d12e01f`):**
  - Routers added: `GET /api/v1/videos` (public feed, sorted by new/popular), `GET /api/v1/videos/search?q=`, `POST /api/v1/videos/{id}/view` (Redis deduplication 60s), `POST /api/v1/videos/{id}/react`, `GET/POST /api/v1/videos/{id}/comments`, `DELETE /api/v1/comments/{id}`, `GET/POST /api/v1/channels/{username}`, `GET/POST/DELETE /api/v1/playlists`, `GET/POST /api/v1/moderation/reports`, `POST /api/v1/moderation/videos/{id}/unhide`.
  - Verified: OpenAPI generated 31 endpoints with 7 tags (`Health`, `Channels`, `Playlists`, `Moderation`, `Comments`, `Auth`, `Videos`).
  - Unit/integration tests (`backend/tests/test_social_and_moderation.py`) and all tests passing (4/4 passed).
- **Stage 6: Frontend (IN PROGRESS):**
  - Initialized React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS in `frontend/`.
  - Created: `frontend/package.json`, `frontend/tsconfig.json`, `frontend/vite.config.ts`, `frontend/tailwind.config.js`, `frontend/postcss.config.js`, `frontend/index.html`, `frontend/src/index.css`, `frontend/src/types.ts`, `frontend/src/api.ts`, `frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx`, `frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx`, `frontend/src/utils.ts`, `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx`, `frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx`, `frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx`.

---

### 3. Key Findings
- **MinIO Docker image:** `minio/minio:latest` cannot be pulled anonymously from Docker Hub / Quay. Resolved by using drop-in fork `pgsty/silo:latest`.
- **Nginx `X-Accel-Redirect` to MinIO:** Direct internal redirect without credentials returned S3 403 because MinIO buckets are private. Resolved by generating internal S3 presigned URLs in `backend/app/core/s3_urls.py` with 300s TTL and redirecting Nginx to `/_internal_s3{presigned_path_and_query}`.
- **SQLAlchemy Async / Redis in Pytest:** Shared global Redis client across event loops in async pytest caused `RuntimeError: Event loop is closed`. Resolved by instantiating fresh Redis client per call in `backend/app/core/redis.py` and configuring `NullPool` in `backend/app/core/database.py`.

---

### 4. Errors & Fixes
- **Error:** `ImportError: email-validator is not installed, run pip install 'pydantic[email]'`.
  - *Fix:* Added `pydantic[email]>=2.9.0,<3.0.0` and `email-validator>=2.2.0,<3.0.0` to `backend/requirements.txt` and rebuilt containers.
- **Error:** Pytest tests failing with `RuntimeError: Task <Task> got Future attached to a different loop`.
  - *Fix:* Configured `backend/pytest.ini` with `asyncio_mode = auto` and `asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = session`, changed database engine pool to `NullPool`, and removed cached event-loop-bound Redis singleton.
- **Error:** Nginx returning `502 Bad Gateway` on `/stream`.
  - *Fix:* Starlette threw `KeyError: None` because response was returned without status_code. Fixed by explicitly returning `Response(content=b"", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK, headers=headers)`.
- **Error:** MinIO returning S3 XML `AccessDenied` on internal Nginx redirect.
  - *Fix:* Implemented `generate_internal_presigned_url` and passed presigned query parameters in `X-Accel-Redirect`.
- **Error:** In `SocialRepository.get_playlist`, stale cached items caused `AssertionError: assert 0 == 1` after adding video to playlist.
  - *Fix:* Added `self.session.expire_all()` in `get_playlist` before executing select with `selectinload`.
- **Error:** Missing imports in `backend/app/repositories/video.py` (`VideoStatus`, `or_`).
  - *Fix:* Imported `or_` from `sqlalchemy` and `VideoStatus` from `app.models.enums`.

---

### 5. Active Context
- Docker Compose stack is running: `postgres`, `redis`, `minio`, `backend`, `worker`, `nginx`.
- `frontend/` has React project structure ready for remaining pages, Docker build configuration, and compilation.
- Nginx already has volume mount `- ./frontend/dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro` and fallback rule `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;` for SPA client-side routing.

---

### 6. Next Steps to Complete Stage 6 & Stage 7
1. **Complete Remaining Frontend Pages in `frontend/src/pages/`:**
   - `frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx`: Search results using horizontal video cards (large thumbnail left, metadata right).
   - `frontend/src/pages/ChannelPage.tsx`: Channel banner, avatar, subscribers, subscribe button, tabs for "Видео" (public/private depending on owner) and "Плейлисты".
   - `frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx`: Drag-and-drop video file input, thumbnail input, upload progress bar with `XMLHttpRequest` or fetch progress, title, description, visibility toggle (`public` / `private`), and private access input.
   - `frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx` & `frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx`: Clean YouTube-style forms with error handling.
   - `frontend/src/pages/ModerationPage.tsx`: Protected route for `moderator` and `admin`, showing pending reports queue with video preview, reason, and buttons "Скрыть видео" / "Отклонить".
2. **App Entrypoints & Layout:**
   - `frontend/src/App.tsx`: React Router configuration (`/`, `/watch/:id`, `/channel/:username`, `/search`, `/upload`, `/login`, `/register`, `/moderation`), Header + Sidebar wrapper.
   - `frontend/src/main.tsx`: React DOM render with `ThemeProvider`, `AuthProvider`, `BrowserRouter`.
3. **Frontend Build & Docker Integration:**
   - Run `npm install` and `npm run build` inside `frontend/` (or via frontend Docker build stage) to produce `frontend/dist`.
   - Update `docker-compose.yml` (or Docker build) to ensure frontend build is automated for clean Ubuntu deployment.
   - Verify all SPA routes by sending HTTP GET to `/watch/123`, `/channel/test`, `/login`, `/search` and verifying Nginx returns `200 OK` with `index.html`.
4. **Stage 6 Verification & Commit:**
   - Commit Stage 6 with `feat: implement react frontend with youtube ui and dark mode`.
5. **Stage 7 (Final Stage):**
   - Create demo seed script (`scripts/seed_demo_data.py` or similar) to populate DB with demo users (user, moderator, admin), videos, comments, playlists.
   - Write comprehensive `README.md` with instructions for one-command deployment (`./deploy.sh` / `make up`), architecture overview, and user credentials.
   - Verify full end-to-end flow: register -> upload -> transcode -> watch -> like & comment.

---

### 7. Commitments & Constraints
- Keep strict layered backend architecture intact (`routers` -> `services` -> `repositories` -> `models`).
- No business logic or SQL queries in routers.
- Conventional Commits for each stage.
- Keep responsive design and light/dark theme support matching YouTube look & feel.

### Этап 6: Разработка Frontend (React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS) — Завершен

Реализован современный SPA-клиент в стилистике YouTube с полноценной поддержкой темной и светлой темы, адаптивной версткой и чистым взаимодействием с бэкендом через `httpOnly` куки:

---

### 1. Архитектура и компоненты Frontend (`frontend/`):
- **Стек:** React 18, TypeScript 5, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, React Router v6.
- **Инфраструктура и сборка:**
  - Создан `nginx/Dockerfile` с **multi-stage сборкой** (`node:20-alpine` -> `nginx:1.27-alpine`). На чистой Ubuntu проект собирается и деплоится в один шаг без необходимости локально устанавливать Node.js/npm.
  - Настроен Nginx на раздачу статики и SPA-роутинг (`try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;`).
- **Контексты (`frontend/src/context/`):**
  - `ThemeContext`: переключение темы (Dark/Light) с сохранением состояния в `localStorage` и классом `dark` на теге `<html>`.
  - `AuthContext`: глобальное состояние текущего пользователя, инициализация через `GET /api/v1/auth/me`, методы `login`, `logout`, `refreshUser`.
- **Каркас (Layout):**
  - `Header`: бургер-меню, логотип YouTube Clone, центрированная поисковая строка, кнопка «Создать» (загрузка видео), тумблер темной/светлой темы, бейдж модератора со ссылкой на модерацию (для ролей `moderator` и `admin`), выпадающее меню профиля пользователя («Мой канал», «Выйти»).
  - `Sidebar`: навигация по разделам («Главная», «Мой канал», «Загрузка видео», блок администрирования «Модерация» для персонала).
- **Экраны и страницы (`frontend/src/pages/`):**
  1. **Главная (`HomePage.tsx` / `/`):**
     - Чипы/фильтры сортировки («Новые» / «Популярные»).
     - Адаптивная сетка карточек видео (`VideoCard.tsx`) с превью 16:9, бейджем длительности, бейджем «Приватное», аватаром автора, названием, каналом, счетчиком просмотров и относительной датой публикации.
  2. **Просмотр видео (`WatchPage.tsx` / `/watch/:id`):**
     - Нативный HTML5 плеер со стримингом (`/api/v1/videos/{id}/stream`), поддержкой `Range`, авто-постером (`/api/v1/videos/{id}/thumbnail`).
     - Блок автора канала, количество подписчиков, динамическая кнопка «Подписаться» / «Вы подписаны».
     - Кнопки лайка и дизлайка с мгновенным обновлением счетчиков.
     - Раскрывающееся описание (аккордеон).
     - Кнопка «Пожаловаться» с модальным окном отправки жалобы модераторам.
     - Для владельца приватного видео — кнопка «Управление доступом» с модальным окном (просмотр списка пользователей с доступом, выдача доступа по логину/email, отзыв доступа).
     - Блок комментариев с добавлением, счетчиком и удалением (для автора комментария, владельца видео или модератора).
  3. **Поиск (`SearchPage.tsx` / `/search?q=...`):**
     - Горизонтальные карточки видео с расширенным сниппетом описания и метаданными.
  4. **Канал (`ChannelPage.tsx` / `/channel/:username`):**
     - Шапка канала с градиентным баннером, аватаром, именем, статистикой (подписчики, количество видео), кнопкой подписки или кнопкой загрузки видео (если свой канал). Вкладки «Видео» и «О канале».
  5. **Загрузка видео (`UploadPage.tsx` / `/upload`):**
     - Drag-and-drop зона выбора файла с валидацией расширения/контейнера (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV).
     - Поля названия и описания.
     - Выбор приватности: `public` vs `private`.
     - Загрузка кастомного превью (или автоматическая генерация через FFmpeg).
     - Реальный индикатор прогресса загрузки (через `XMLHttpRequest.upload.onprogress`).
  6. **Вход и Регистрация (`LoginPage.tsx`, `RegisterPage.tsx`):**
     - YouTube/Google-стиль карточек с валидацией, сообщениями об ошибках и автоматической авторизацией.
  7. **Модерация (`ModerationPage.tsx` / `/moderation`):**
     - Очередь жалоб для модераторов и администраторов, просмотр видео, причина жалобы, действия «Скрыть видео» (`hide`) и «Отклонить жалобу» (`dismiss`).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Seed script for YouTube Clone MVP.
Populates PostgreSQL and MinIO with test users, videos (generated via FFmpeg),
thumbnails, comments, reactions, subscriptions, playlists, access grants, and moderation reports.

Idempotent: safe to run multiple times without duplicating data or failing.
"""

import asyncio
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import async_session_factory
from app.core.security import get_password_hash
from app.core.storage import get_s3_client
from app.models.community import Comment, Report, Subscription, VideoReaction
from app.models.enums import ReportStatus, UserRole, VideoStatus, VideoVisibility
from app.models.playlist import Playlist, PlaylistItem
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.video import Video, VideoAccess

DEFAULT_PASSWORD = "Password123!"

SEED_USERS = [
    {
        "username": "admin",
        "email": "admin@youtube.local",
        "role": UserRole.ADMIN,
        "channel_name": "Admin Channel",
        "channel_description": "Официальный канал администратора платформы YouTube Clone",
    },
    {
        "username": "moderator",
        "email": "moderator@youtube.local",
        "role": UserRole.MODERATOR,
        "channel_name": "Moderator Channel",
        "channel_description": "Служба модерации контента и рассмотрения жалоб",
    },
    {
        "username": "creator",
        "email": "creator@youtube.local",
        "role": UserRole.USER,
        "channel_name": "Tech Creator",
        "channel_description": "Канал о веб-разработке, микросервисах, Docker и архитектуре",
    },
    {
        "username": "viewer",
        "email": "viewer@youtube.local",
        "role": UserRole.USER,
        "channel_name": "Casual Viewer",
        "channel_description": "Любитель качественного видеоконтента и технологий",
    },
]

SEED_VIDEOS = [
    {
        "title": "Tech Review: Cloud Architecture 2026",
        "description": "Обзор современных архитектурных паттернов для highload видеохостингов: S3, Nginx Range-стриминг и асинхронные воркеры.",

    {

        "description": "Пошаговое написание сервиса стриминга видео на FastAPI с раздачей через X-Accel-Redirect и поддержкой HTTP 206 Partial Content.",
        "color": "darkgreen",
        "duration": 5,
        "visibility": VideoVisibility.PUBLIC,
        "views_count": 3890,
        "likes_count": 210,
        "dislikes_count": 4,
    },
    {
        "title": "DevOps & Docker Compose: Production Ubuntu Deployment",
        "description": "Развертывание полного стека (PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, MinIO, Nginx, Celery/Arq) на чистом сервере Ubuntu одной командой.",
        "color": "indigo",
        "duration": 3,
        "visibility": VideoVisibility.PUBLIC,
        "views_count": 940,
        "likes_count": 78,
        "dislikes_count": 0,
    },
    {
        "title": "Game Highlights & Speedrun World Records",
        "description": "Самые захватывающие моменты прохождений игр на максимальной скорости и секретные техники управления.",
        "color": "maroon",
        "duration": 4,
        "visibility": VideoVisibility.PUBLIC,
        "views_count": 6200,
        "likes_count": 412,
        "dislikes_count": 15,
    },
    {
        "title": "Private Vlog: Creator Backstage & Unreleased Footage",
        "description": "Эксклюзивные закулисные материалы и черновики. Видео доступно только по закрытому списку доступа (для зрителя viewer).",
        "color": "teal",

    },

        "color": "darkred",
